name: Komm
description: A self-hosted voice, video, and text chat platform built end-to-end across five repositories. Engineered the WebRTC audio pipeline using AEC3 echo cancellation, RNNoise noise suppression, and Silero VAD for voice activity detection. Designed an mTLS trust model securing communication across every service.

name: Jolt
tagline: Desktop apps with web UIs, in plain Java
description: A Java framework for building desktop apps with web UIs, with no Electron, no JNI, and no native code to compile. Built on Java 25's Foreign Function & Memory API, it opens a native window around the system web view (WebView2 on Windows, WebKitGTK on Linux) and lets Java and the page exchange messages in one process, with no HTTP server in between. Published on Maven Central, with a full docs site.

name: QueryExe
description: A free, cross-platform desktop client for relational databases (MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, H2, and SQLite). Multi-connection SQL editor with autocomplete, concurrent query execution, and direct result-grid editing. Built on Jolt: Java owns connections, SQL execution and storage, while a Vue 3 interface runs in a native window in a single process, for Windows and Linux.

name: Parsel
description: A desktop mail client for your own mailbox: read and send over IMAP and SMTP with no cloud and no account but yours. Built on Jolt as the reference real-world app: Java handles the mail, a Vue 3 page draws the interface, and both run in one process, packaged for Windows and Linux.

name: Smart Home
description: An Android app for real-time monitoring and control of a Zigbee-based smart home, integrating multiple sensors over MQTT and WebSocket. The Spring Boot backend fuses power-consumption, tilt, and vibration readings to detect door state and flag stuck conditions automatically, with role-based admin access and activity logging.

name: Marina Labs
description: A Singapore Peppol/InvoiceNow document validation platform featuring a two-stage XSD and Schematron pipeline that validates UBL e-invoices against official Singapore Peppol specifications and generates PDFs through the official XSLT stylesheets, packaged as a Java/Spring Boot + Node.js full-stack app with one-command Docker Compose deployment.

name: EmojiFX
description: A JavaFX library that brings proper emoji rendering to desktop apps, with support for multiple emoji styles. Published on Maven Central for any JavaFX project to pull in directly.
